### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **3** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`  _(via getTypes (sdk, the bare tail of client method meta.getTypes, bound to GET /api/v1/meta), meta.getTypes (sdk, the route ledger binds it to GET /api/v1/meta))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `/api/v1/meta (route, 47 pages)`
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8ca9dd7baa595715f36c2282467bb72a3b235b19` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `b479d18c9c1d9b343d4570f75cf9154d205ebcf9` — the merge of head `01d462ad336c652c1347306494aa343d2fb2e269` into base `8ca9dd7baa595715f36c2282467bb72a3b235b19`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin b479d18c9c1d9b343d4570f75cf9154d205ebcf9 && git checkout b479d18c9c1d9b343d4570f75cf9154d205ebcf9
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8ca9dd7baa595715f36c2282467bb72a3b235b19 01d462ad336c652c1347306494aa343d2fb2e269 && git checkout -B drift-repro 8ca9dd7baa595715f36c2282467bb72a3b235b19 && git merge --no-ff 01d462ad336c652c1347306494aa343d2fb2e269

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8ca9dd7baa595715f36c2282467bb72a3b235b19
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8ca9dd7baa595715f36c2282467bb72a3b235b19` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d241313d3764248e5a1bf5da253c0be523daa8ae`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.packageless-overlay-write-closed.ts + packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts (the ceremony: `classifyPackagelessRow`, `addedMemberOf`, `migratePackagelessOverlays` L514–560, `packagelessCloseSubject` L693–718), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts (`overrideWriteVerdict` L675–686, `overrideWriteMemberOf`), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts (`overlayBaseShippers` L10463, the `overrideWriteVerdict` host L11427), packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/packageless-overlays.ts (the preview printer L384–385, `jsonRow` L96), packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts (L906 / L912 control, L970–1075), packages/spec/scripts/build-upgrade-guide.ts (the entry's first consumer, L153–155), packages/spec/src/migrations/types.ts (`SemanticMigration`), packages/metadata-core/src/item-key-discriminators.ts. The remainder of the diff, `.changeset/28576-packageless-overlay-write-closed.md`, is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

### ① Derived judgments

Read against the head's tree. The six cited files are byte-identical between the merge-base `32912139` and `origin/main` `aca58cdb`, so the PR body's line citations still name the live code.

- **No accept-set change, no public-surface change.** The diff touches one unreleased ADR-0087 semantic entry (prose fields only: header comment, `replacement`, `reason`, `acceptanceCriteria`; `id` and `surface` untouched) and one pending changeset. No runtime file, no schema, no export, no generated artifact moves; the generated upgrade-guide pages are gitignored. Right.
- **Check-runs on the head at read time:** `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success, `PR-body guards` success, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` success, `Spec property liveness` success, `Check PR Size` success; `Check Changeset` **failure** (judged in ②: the designed red of the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class, not a required context); the required contexts `Lint · *`, `Type Check · *`, `Test Core (1–8/8)`, `Build Core`, `Live E2E UI` still `in_progress`. Nothing green is claimed here that the check-runs did not say.
- **The `replacement`'s own-member clause is right.** `migratePackagelessOverlays` saves an `addedMember` row into the pair with its `overrides` key stripped (L525–531), reads it back as the member's own row declaring nothing (`isOwnMemberRow`, L535), and pushes `{ outcome: 'moved', packageId, addedMember }` (L558–560); the `PackagelessOverlayOutcome` union (L191–193) carries `addedMember` in place of `basedOn` exactly as the prose says. Pinned at objectql L1002 and L1031.
- **The missing-version clause is right.** `basedOn` is read only when `addedMember` is undefined (L515–516), so "for a declared override, the base's missing version" is the one true scoping.
- **"An added member's package-less write stays open, before and after its move" is right against the close.** `packagelessCloseSubject` builds the DECLARED body unconditionally (L711–714: `overrides: { package: base, basedOn }`) and returns `null` on any gate refusal (L716). The gate's `closure.shippers` is computed at the body's member (`overrideWriteIdentityOf`), so a base shipping `en-US` alone answers `declared_package_ships_no_such_item` (L675–682) for a `zh-CN` declaration — before the move (the stored unbound row is `movable`, L906 pins it beside the L912 control) and after it (no unbound row is stored, so `body` is the written body or none, `shadowOf` answers nothing when `stored` is undefined, the row classifies `movable`, the same declared body is refused). The after-move half is reasoned from the code, not pinned by a test; see ④.
- **"A row of an email template locale" is exactly the population.** `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS` holds `email_template` alone, so no other overlay type can carry an `addedMember`. Right.
- **`reason` and `acceptanceCriteria`** now scope the 403 and the "moved … declared" save to declared-override moves; both hold against L693–718 and L1066 (a declared save at the unshipped locale into the pair answers 403 after the move; an undeclared one is the pair's own row). Right.
- **`surface` is left over-broad — wrong.** See ④, must-fix.
- **The PR body's "the preview names it `addedMember`"** holds for `--json` (`jsonRow` L96) only; the human preview prints "(its own member; BASE ships none at LOCALE)" (L384–385). See ④, should-fix.

### ② Semver level

- The PR declares `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` in its body and adds no changeset of its own. Right: the diff publishes no behaviour; the entry is unreleased and ships with the pending changeset's release, whose frontmatter (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol: minor`, `@objectstack/spec: patch`, `@objectstack/skills: patch`, `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`) and declaration tokens (`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`) are unchanged by this diff — only their trailing prose is corrected. `check-changeset-no-major` on the head read `Clause-②: no` + `Metadata-protocol: none`, "a non-protocol change at `patch`" (job log). `Clause-②:` line: right.
- `Check Changeset` is red because the PR changes a changeset it did not add. The gate's own header names two classes with opposite remedies; this diff is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class (the pending note describes behaviour #29258 changed), whose remedy is "do NOT restore it — say so on the PR, get it confirmed". The PR body says so under *Acceptance notes*. The context is not one of the ten the queue enforces; the confirmation the gate routes to is the lane seat's ACCEPT on this remainder. Recorded, not a finding of this record.
- For the lane seat's remainder, two text observations (not ④ findings; the changeset is outside `hits`): (a) the **Now refused** bullet, unchanged here, still ends "and the override write gate admits that row into the pair" — for an added member the undeclared row IS admitted (the gate answers `not_concerned` at L686 when no shipper holds the member), so that bullet now reads as closing the very write the new **Still open** sentence keeps open; "admits that row, declared as the base's override, into the pair" would close the gap. (b) the new FROM → TO sentence "`DELETE …?package=BASE.custom` removes it" needs the member selector for a non-canonical locale (`?member=zh-CN`): a delete naming no member addresses the canonical member (objectql L488 vs L445).

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev's os-dev-report is card comment 6581404094. Every flag and the one open question, answered:

1. **File surface wider than the claim** (`reason`, `acceptanceCriteria`, header comment; in the changeset the headline, the token prose, the Upgrade paragraph, the `movable` bullet) — **accepted**: the card's *Wanted* is "re-read both texts against the ceremony's real outcomes and correct them", and each added field carried the same false predicate. The claim's file surface is amended to those fields by this record. ⛔ The widening stopped one field short: `surface` carries the same predicate and is this card's, not #29393's (④).
2. **Line citations in the PR body, not the changeset** — right; release prose must not carry source line numbers.
3. **`Fixes #29261` on line 3 behind the harness attribution block** — the named os-dev exemption; accepted.
4. **Relay `pr_create` 502 then retry; body read back identical** — accepted, one PR exists.
5. **Not subscribed to PR activity** — the dispatch contract's; accepted.
6. **open_questions — fold #29393 or keep serial?** → **A, keep serial.** #29393 is outside this record's inputs; this card's correction is reviewable on its own, and `reason` is two sentences to rebase. ⛔ That answer does not transfer the `surface` qualifier to #29393: #29393 widens for the base-named write (#28905); the added-member qualifier is the correction this card asked for.
7. **out_of_scope — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L132** says a pre-D11 unbound row's "package-less save, reset and rollback are refused once movable (D11)", false for an added-member row (movable, write open) — **escalated to the seat**: Tier H governed surface, its own card under `domain:spec`; the pending changeset's `Skills-docs:` line quotes that sentence and stays an accurate quotation until that card lands, then follows it.
8. **carrier — the option-B close card** (close the added member's package-less write) — **noted as a standing dependency**: if it lands, every "stays open" sentence this PR adds in both texts flips and must be edited in that PR. The seat holds it.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.packageless-overlay-write-closed.ts`, judged against the ceremony and the close it describes, and against its first consumer, `build-upgrade-guide.ts`, which renders each semantic entry as one line: the `surface` code span, then an arrow, then the `replacement`, with `reason` and `acceptanceCriteria` under it (L153–155).

- **must-fix — `surface` still states the predicate this card was filed to correct.** It reads "…where `os migrate packageless-overlays` would move the row into that package's paired BASE.custom". The ceremony WOULD move an added-member row into the pair (L514–560), and that write is NOT closed (`packagelessCloseSubject` L711–716, objectql L906). So the entry's headline names a write as refused that stays open, and the `replacement` three words later says it stays open: the one guide line contradicts itself on exactly the row the PR exists to describe. The dev's "that is #29393's widening" is the PR body's account; the tree has the predicate unqualified. Fix, in the same field: "…would move the row into that package's paired BASE.custom as a declared override (a row it moves as the pair's own member, an email template locale the base does not ship, keeps the write)". Ten words; no runtime file, no test, no generated artifact.
- **should-fix — "(the preview names it `addedMember`)".** The literal key appears in the `--json` result only (`jsonRow` L96); the human preview prints "(its own member; BASE ships none at LOCALE)" (L384–385), and the `--apply` line prints "as its own member LOCALE" (L406). An operator reading the plain preview looks for a token it never prints. Say "the preview lists it as the pair's own member; `--json` carries it as `addedMember`".
- **should-fix — the added member's DELETE address.** "`DELETE /api/v1/meta/TYPE/NAME?package=BASE.custom` to restore the package original (an added member's removes it)": for a non-canonical locale the pair's delete needs `?member=LOCALE`; without it the door addresses the canonical member (objectql L488, L445). The generic address elides the member everywhere in this entry, so the omission is the document's convention, not this PR's invention — but the parenthetical is specifically about a membered row, so name the selector there.
- **observation, no fix owed** — the after-move half of "stays open, before and after its move" is read off L693–718 (no stored unbound row → the written body or none → `movable` → the same declared body → refused) and is not pinned by any test; L906 pins the before-move half and L1066 pins the pair-named declared save after the move. The sentence is true on the tree; a pin of the package-less save after the move belongs to the option-B close card, whichever way it rules.
- Everything else in the hits file holds: the own-member move (L525–560, L191–193), the dropped failed-move example, the declared-override scoping of the 403 and of the missing-version failure (L515–516), the acceptance criterion (L1066), the header comment, the "email template locale" population (`ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改文字。把本次发版新增的升级说明条目 `packageless-overlay-write-closed` 和它的 changeset 改准：迁移命令把「基础包没提供的邮件模板语言版本」作为配对包自己的成员搬过去，不声明覆盖；这一行的无包写入在搬迁前后都不会被拒。
- 为什么改：#28904（PR #29258）改了迁移命令的行为，原文还说「每次搬迁都声明覆盖」「这种行搬不过去」，升级指南会误导运维。
- 风险与回滚：没有运行时改动，任何接口的接受/拒绝结果都不变。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.packageless-overlay-write-closed.ts` 的 `surface` 和 `replacement` 两段。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:upgrade-guide`，预期退出 0，生成的升级指南里出现 `&member=<locale>` 和「pair's own member」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

席位意见：可落地。契约复审第一轮 FAIL（6581627406，一处 surface 措辞），第二轮在现 head PASS（见本 PR 上一条记录）。CI 除按设计变红的 Check Changeset 外全绿。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:spec#4` · head `01d462ad`

1. **Shape:** draft, base `main`, `Fixes #29261`. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` sit at line start in the body; the edited changeset is the pending `28576` one, whose own lines are unchanged. 2 files, +45/−34, both inside the claim surface as amended on #29261.
